description: Audit every ACTIVE campaign's ACTIVE ad squads (read-only): no buyer exclusion, high frequency, low swipe rate, low ROAS, spend with no purchases, squads under a paused campaign. Returns the ad squad ids to act on.

end_time.description: A day (YYYY-MM-DD: the whole day is included, so it means the start of the next day in SNAP_REPORT_UTC_OFFSET) or an ISO date-time on the hour with an offset, such as 2026-10-20T00:00:00+03:00 (Snap needs whole hours).

max_frequency.description: Flag ad squads whose average views per person is above this.

min_roas.description: Flag items whose return on ad spend is below this (for example 2 means 2x).

min_spend.description: Ignore items that spent less than this, in account currency (too little data to judge).

min_swipe_rate_pct.description: Flag ads whose swipe rate (percent) is below this.

name: snap_health_check
